PARES show/2208061 by curl and in the browser: HTTP 429 both times.

Bergenroth's 1868 Supplement (BHO), April 1507: nos. 14 (f. 31, in cipher, deciphered by Almazán) and 15 (f. 32), both Puebla to Ferdinand, 15 Apr 1507, printed in full Spanish; CSP Spain I nos. 511-512 pp. 408-410 calendar the same two letters (found by a parallel session, checked here).
Supplement nos. 14-15 read through in Spanish and English: both texts coherent throughout; f. 31's content agrees with the CSP Spain I no. 511 abstract.

texts.label: f. 31, Puebla to Ferdinand, 15 Apr 1507 (Supp. no. 14)
texts.summary: Henry VII has recovered from quinsy; Puebla showed him the deciphered despatch of 15 March at Richmond; the dowry payment is postponed only to Michaelmas, jewels accepted only at London prices; Henry will send an ambassador with full powers to marry Queen Juana per verba de praesenti as soon as Ferdinand writes from Castile.
texts.note: Decryption and translation: Bergenroth's printed Spanish text (Almazán's decipherment, gaps completed by the editor) and his English translation, Supplement (1868) no. 14 (linked, not copied). No transcription of the ciphertext (PARES images not reached).

reading_review.note: Bergenroth's printed Spanish text and his English translation read through as sentences on the BHO page; the cipher itself was not seen.

texts.label: f. 32, Puebla to Ferdinand, 15 Apr 1507 (Supp. no. 15)
texts.summary: Short duplicate sent in a Lucca merchant's bag in case the courier Perote is stopped by French troops in Italy: the dowry postponed to Michaelmas; Henry waits for Ferdinand's arrival in Castile to send his embassy for the marriage with the Queen of Castile.
texts.note: Decryption and translation: Bergenroth's printed Spanish text and English translation, Supplement (1868) no. 15 (linked).

reading_review.note: Bergenroth's printed Spanish text and his English translation read through as sentences on the BHO page; the cipher itself was not seen.
